style: You are narrating a cinematic documentary trailer about a company run entirely by AI. Speak like a warm, confident documentary narrator: natural and human, unhurried, with small breaths and pauses between phrases, a quiet sense of wonder on the striking lines, and a smile in the voice on the lighter ones. Never robotic, never rushed.

lines.cold1: What if a company could run itself?
lines.cold2: Not a dashboard. Not a chatbot. A whole company.
lines.intro: Meet AI Company Health. A private health insurer in Australia, with fifty employees across twelve departments. And not one of them is human.
lines.town: Their customers aren't human either. This is Wattle Grove, home to just over a hundred AI residents. Each one has a job, an income, a house, a family, and a memory that's entirely their own.
lines.resident: Click on anyone, and their whole life opens up. Where they work, what they earn, who they live with, which health fund they're with, and why. Every claim, every conversation, every memory they've kept.
lines.resident2: Health cover is compulsory here, so every resident picks a fund. There are nine rival funds, and us. And here's the thing. The company's numbers aren't simulated. Every sale, every claim, every dollar comes from a decision one of these residents actually made.
lines.office: Back at headquarters, the team works across three floors. Click on Leo, our head of sales, and you're standing in his department, right beside him.
lines.tokens: Every agent keeps a running tally of what it costs them to think. Tokens in, tokens out, every single model call, day by day. You always know exactly who's spending what.
lines.chat_ask: And you can simply talk to him.
lines.chat_reply: That's a live answer, generated on the spot. Leo checked the real numbers with his own tools, and he'll remember this conversation tomorrow.
lines.meet_call: Need your team in a room? Open Meet, choose a room, pick who you want, and give them an agenda. Then, call the meeting.
lines.meet_walk: And they come. Out of their departments, into the lifts, and up to the boardroom. Nobody moves unless they're asked to.
lines.meet_present: Each of them builds a deck from the live data, and presents it, right there on the boardroom screen. Then someone writes up the minutes.
lines.sold: Up the top, this counter tracks every membership sold. Click it, and you get the whole story. Who joined, which fund they left, and, in their own words, why.
lines.docs: Everything the agents make lands here. Decks, reports, dashboards, even small apps. And every single number is fact-checked against the data. Get one wrong, and it's flagged. And the agent remembers the lesson.
lines.timeline: The timeline lets you replay the company, day by day. Every sale, every campaign, every competitor move. Even every new baby in town.
lines.ops: And this, is the engine room. Model calls per minute, quota, what the day is costing, and which agents are burning through the most tokens.
lines.traces: Every decision can be traced. Open any run, and see exactly which tools the agent reached for, and what came back.
lines.goals: Every Monday, the CEO reviews last week's goals, and sets new ones. And these evaluations keep everyone honest, checking that agents answer with real numbers, not guesses.
lines.outro: Google's Agent Development Kit. Vertex AI. Agents talking to agents over A2A. LangGraph running the workflows. All of it, on Google Cloud.
lines.final: This is AI Company Health. The company that runs itself.
